scripts.build:web: rm -rf dist-web && VITE_LATURAIVO_WEB_RELEASE=1 vite build --outDir dist-web
scripts.build:steam: rm -rf dist-steam && VITE_LATURAIVO_STEAM=1 vite build --outDir dist-steam
scripts.steam:package:mac: npm run build:steam && npm run steam:stage && electron-packager release/steam/LaturaivoSteamStage Laturaivo --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release/steam --overwrite --prune=false
scripts.steam:package:win: npm run build:steam && npm run steam:stage && electron-packager release/steam/LaturaivoSteamStage Laturaivo --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release/steam --overwrite --prune=false
scripts.steam:package:linux: npm run build:steam && npm run steam:stage && electron-packager release/steam/LaturaivoSteamStage Laturaivo --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out=release/steam --overwrite --prune=false
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init LATURAIVO fi.ubercreative.laturaivo --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npm run sync:ios-assets && npm run sync:ugames-sfx
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:build && npm run cap:open:ios
